preconditions.description: The length of the original string s is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The length of the desired string is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The length of the string s is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is exactly k.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] <= stdout[i+1] for i in range(len(stdout)-1) if stdout[i] != stdout[i+1])
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically smallest among all possible strings of length k that can be obtained by the allowed operations.
